title: All TOSS 5 local files and directories must have a valid owner.
check_content:
Verify all local files and directories on TOSS 5 have a valid owner using the following command:

$ df --local -P | awk {'if (NR!=1) print $6'} | sudo xargs -I '{}' find '{}' -xdev -nouser

If any files on the system do not have an assigned owner, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Either remove all files and directories from the system that do not have a valid user, or assign a valid user to all unowned files and directories on TOSS 5 with the "chown" command:

$ sudo chown <user> <file>
VulnDiscussion: Unowned files and directories may be unintentionally inherited if a user is assigned the same user identifier "UID" as the UID of the unowned files.
